question: What bodily and perceptual powers result from mastery of the third wheel?
premises: Wrinkles and grey hair are destroyed
Seeing from very far is attained
These are presented as parallel results
inference: Mastery brings the destruction of wrinkles and grey hair and the power to see from very far away
plain_english: It brings the destruction of wrinkles and grey hair, and likewise the ability to see from very far away.
